mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia may increase seizure risk in patients taking praziquantel, which itself can lower seizure threshold; both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism with potential for altered clearance.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium and magnesium) before and during concurrent use; consider potassium-sparing alternative or electrolyte supplementation; assess seizure risk factors and counsel patient on seizure precautions.
